title: Metering Charges — Meter Reconfiguration on Ending a Net Energy Metering Agreement
content:
When a Net Energy Metering agreement is ended at the customer's request, a meter reconfiguration charge is deducted from the bank according to the type of Metering Service meter in service at the address.

**Rule.** When the meter in service at the address is an AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter, the meter reconfiguration charge is the three-phase reconfiguration charge of 60.00. When the meter in service is an AMI Bidirectional Net Meter, it is the single-phase reconfiguration charge of 35.00. Otherwise, for interval demand and primary metering installations that are reprogrammed remotely, there is none.

**Records read.** The Metering Service installation in service at the address of the service agreement hosting the system, and its meter type.

## Charge by meter in service

| Meter in service at the address | Reconfiguration charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | 60.00 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | 35.00 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter or Primary Metering Installation (reprogrammed remotely) | None |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A home whose Metering Service record shows an AMI Bidirectional Net Meter in service: 35.00.
- A shop whose record shows an AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter in service: 60.00.
- A plant whose record shows a Primary Metering Installation in service: no charge.
